data.body: Verified -1 on patchset 1 root-caused: checkout predated Gerrit 1809, which ratcheted create_cli's complexity ceiling 22->21 in .github/complexity-baseline.json; CI's lock step read our stale 22 as an admin-only raise. Fix: rebased onto origin/main (picking up create_cli=21) — no baseline edit, no composer.py change. Critical check passed: under ruff 0.16.2 create_cli scores 21 (ruff check --select C901 shows only create_core at 21; check_complexity_baseline.py --check: active=51 new=0 increased=0 stale=0), so the ruff bump stays IN. Post-rebase gates green: make lint, make typecheck, uv lock --check, targeted pandoc modules 83/83. Re-pushed change 1812 as patchset 2 (same Change-Id Idfcf949fdec).
